question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

LACONIC
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Concise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Laconic"** means using very few words to express oneself, often to the point of being terse or concise. (संक्षिप्त)
 
 
• **Example:** His laconic reply, "No," ended the conversation abruptly.
 
 
• **"Concise"** refers to giving information clearly and briefly, without unnecessary words, making it synonymous with "laconic." (संक्षिप्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The professor gave a concise summary of the chapter before moving forward.
